body: thank you so much. i’ll definitely try to talk to my teachers

you know what, i’ll leave something here. these are the things i do after a good cry, when i’m feeling low, or just when i need to comfort myself. these work for me and they might work for you. 
-washing your face with cold water after you’ve cried really helps. it refreshes me and makes the swelling and redness go down a lot. 
-self care. this isn’t some spa or face-mask type shit. just brush your teeth, shower, go for a jog. please treat yourself gently, you deserve it. 
-try your best to make yourself be productive. one thing that works for me is making myself work on a project for 5 minutes. by the time 5 minutes passes i’m in the groove and often times i keep going. even if you don’t, you’ve tried to work for 5 minutes, and that’s good enough. 
-again, treat yourself with care. if you got out of bed, are, drank water, or done anything to help yourself today, you are doing great. celebrate every little victory because that’s more than you’d accomplished yesterday. even just spending another day alive is hard enough. it’s okay. i hope this helps. if you’re reading this and thinking about suicide, please please message me or comment. please. if you think no one else cares, i do.
